consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1978-09-16 show at the Son Et Lumiere Theater is a standout performance, particularly in the context of the Egypt shows. Many reviewers highlight the emotional playing and unique atmosphere, although some note that it may not reach the heights of other 1978 performances.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 46 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the emotional depth and unique setting of the show, there were notable criticisms regarding performance consistency and sound quality, leading to a mixed overall sentiment.
